title: Autonomous Assessment Agent
intro: Processes check items defined in natural language through a single flow: script generation → human approval → collection → automatic judgment. Two human-confirmation gates are enforced.

banner.llm: 🔒 Judgment and generation are handled by the in-house LLM (LSAP). External transmission (Claude) is {state}.
banner.noLsap: The in-house LLM (LSAP) is not configured (LLM_ENDPOINT). Scripts fall back to templates, and auto judgment is handled as not checkable (hold).

newItem.title: ① New Check Item Intake (natural language)
newItem.desc: Register new CVE / security guide / customer custom criteria with a natural-language description only.
newItem.phTitle: Title (if empty, the start of the description is used)
newItem.phDescription: Describe the check criteria in natural language. e.g.) Verify that /etc/passwd permissions are 644 or less. If greater, regular users can modify it — vulnerable.

list.title: Check Items ({n})
list.empty: No items registered yet. Add an item above.

actions.confirmRun: The approved script will run on the target server. Proceed?
actions.credNote: Only targets with credentials registered in Server Management can be run.
actions.phRawOutput: Paste the raw result of running the approved script on the target system.
actions.confirmExternal: Raw data will be sent externally (Claude). Proceed?

direct.title: ⌨ Provide script directly (instead of NL generation)
direct.hint: Upload or paste a check script (e.g. ad_collect.ps1) to run remotely.
direct.globHint: Path where the script writes its result. Empty = auto-detect; if not found, stdout is collected.
direct.forceConfirm: The safety gate flagged this script as risky. You reviewed it and approve execution?
direct.forceHint: Safety gate blocked — force approve under operator responsibility
